summary: Intermittent negative balance and missing cache-warmup credits after rate-limiter refunds
description: Issue summary: Customer reports an unexpected negative account balance and apparent loss of cache-warmup credits after a weekend of high retry traffic. Impact: Lexicon Health dashboard shows a -$2,430 balance and invoice lines indicating refunds applied to a subset of rate-limited requests, while cache-warmup credits for the same timewindow are absent from the finalized invoice. Environment: Production (us-east-1), mix of hosted and dedicated fallbacks. Steps to reproduce: 1) Run high-concurrency embed calls (redwood-embed-v1) with simulated transient 429s (client retry). 2) Observe that meter postbacks for refunded requests are issued and later followed by cache-warmup postbacks. 3) Check billing ledger for refunded token lines and cache-warmup credits. Observed behavior: Refunds from rate-limiter are processed before cache-warmup credits; in the reconciliation pipeline the refunded postbacks appear to cancel corresponding charges and the cache-warmup credits are dropped by the deduplication/ordering logic, yielding net negative charge lines. Expected behavior: Refunds should be applied and netted after cache-warmup credits are accounted, or both should be preserved and reconciled so customer does not see negative finalized balance. Logs / Evidence: Customer attached invoice PDF, sample postback IDs, and a short capture of postback ordering. Provided IDs: postback_txn: pb_20260307_8c3f, pb_20260307_refund_8c3f, cache_warmup_postback: cw_20260307_8c3f. Customer impact: billing shows temporary negative balance, autopay attempted and failed, customer disabled autopay and requested immediate explanation and provisional credit. Workaround requested: provisional credit or waiver until root cause fixed.
